column1: # Keyword prefix parity cases (issue #96). One case per line, tab-separated:
# The case deck is <deck> with the one occurrence of <find> replaced by <replace>
# (\n and \t escapes allowed). expect is either
#   same        the run gives the same .out bytes as <deck> itself, or
#   refuse:NNN  the run is refused and the report has ERROR NNN.
# Every expectation is checked against EPA SWMM 5.2.4 and OpenSWMM 5.3.0 by
# Section headers: legacy findmatch over SectWords, a header that begins with a
# YES/NO and OFF/ON flags: legacy findmatch over NoYesWords / OffOnWords; a
# word that begins with neither is ERROR 205.
